audiences.executive: One place for shared files that recovers quickly from ransomware and shows who touched what.
audiences.technical: Scale-out file services with snapshots, audit, ransomware detection, and cold data moved to cheaper storage.
audiences.financial: Fewer file servers and filers to renew; cold data on cheaper storage by policy.

people: The owner of file services or storage
A business team with large shares
The desktop team, for profiles and home drives

objections.says: Our filer works: why change it?
objections.clarify: When is it up for renewal, and how long would a restore after ransomware take today?
objections.answer: Compare at renewal on recovery, audit and cost, not on features alone.
objections.prove: Restore a share after a simulated encryption and time it.

objections.says: Moving shares means downtime and broken paths.
objections.clarify: How do users reach the shares today, and which paths are written into scripts or applications?
objections.answer: Keep the names users reach, copy in the background, and cut over in a short window.
objections.prove: Move a test share, cut over in a set window, and check users reach it by the same name.

objections.says: We cannot even see what is in the shares.
objections.clarify: What would you want answered: who accessed what, what is old, what is sensitive?
objections.answer: Start with an analysis of access and age: it guides cleanup, tiering and permissions.
objections.prove: Produce an access and age report on a test share and act on one finding.
